title: red plank
description: this mod adds a red plank to minecraft
body:
This is my very first Minecraft mod, and I’m excited to share it with you! In this mod, I’ve added a simple but fun addition to the game: the Red Plank. That’s right—just a brand-new plank block that brings a pop of color to your builds. The Red Plank can be crafted just like any other standard plank in Minecraft, making it easy to integrate into your existing projects or use as a creative accent in your designs.

I know it’s a small change, but sometimes it’s the little things that make building more fun and give your world a unique touch. Whether you’re constructing a house, a castle, or just want a splash of red in your structures, this plank is a straightforward way to do it. It fits seamlessly with the vanilla Minecraft style, so it won’t feel out of place in your world.

Since this is my first mod, I’d love to hear your feedback! If you enjoy it, feel free to share ideas for future updates or additional blocks you’d like to see. I hope you have as much fun using this Red Plank as I had creating it. Let’s make Minecraft a little brighter, one plank at a time!
